summary: Infantry civ with a strong relic game. Prelates speed up its economy early, and relics placed in towers and keeps make its defenses much stronger.

spikes.label: Early Men-at-Arms
spikes.detail: HRE gets Men-at-Arms in the Feudal Age, earlier than most civs, and its infantry move faster.
spikes.answer: Expect early infantry pressure. Ranged units with bonus damage and a defensive tower near your gold buy time.

spikes.label: Relics in towers and keeps
spikes.detail: Every relic garrisoned in an outpost, tower or keep raises its armor, damage and range by 25%. HRE reaching Castle Age with several relics is hard to break.
spikes.answer: Contest relics as soon as Castle Age hits, and avoid fighting under their relic towers.
